name: dev-loop
description: Six-step dev workflow orchestrator (requirements → design → implement → QA → ship → retro) that routes each step to the best installed skill, chains upstream artifacts into downstream inputs, and supports full-loop or single-step use.
descriptionZh: 六步研发闭环编排器：需求→设计→实现→验收→交付→复盘。每步路由到环境中最合适的已安装 skill，上游产物注入下游形成闭环；可整条运行，也可只用其中任意一步。内置每步兜底，不依赖特定 skill 也能跑。
